hero.words: Proud to be a family-run food wholesaler since 1962!

slider.words: Their delivery is always on time and the product range is unmatched. We switched from our previous supplier 3 years ago and have not looked back.

timeline.words: One of the UK’s first halal butchers and greengrocers.
A dedicated wholesale business for caterers and shops.
Direct imports and our own packing line, still running.
Supplying the UK and Europe from Birmingham.

steps.words: Tell us about your business in a short form. It takes about five minutes.
Our team checks your details and sets up your account with trade pricing.
Order through your account manager by phone or email, with UK-wide delivery.

layeredHero.words: The same designer shades. A good deal less.
I'm an optician in Birmingham, buying from the same suppliers as the high street and pricing it more sensibly. If you need your prescription in them, I glaze and fit the lenses myself.

testimonial.words: I received the strawberry and milk chocolate chip cookies. I gave half of them to my SIL, who is also postpartum. They were fresh, soft and delicious! … I think these would be lovely to gift a new Mum.

reviews.words: Had a lovely experience taking my daughter here. The optician Fatima is very good with children and made the experience enjoyable for my daughter. The receptionist was also very welcoming.

Took my mum as emergency appointment. A day before spoke to fatima on call, fatima also did a video call for my mum. Got an urgent appointment next morning. Explained next few steps and booked my mum for a follow up appointment for a next week. Highly recommended, great service. 👍

I have had the pleasure of being a patient of Ward End Eye Care since it first opened a few years ago. I have been extremely impressed by Fatima (the optician), as she has always ensured that she thoroughly checks my eyes during my eye tests. The equipment that Fatima uses is state of the art and the health of her patients is paramount.
